title: POST /hitch/v1/items/:id/state
description: A person-client uses an item verb the item offers. Narrow tier: no presence. Mods, apps and sessions get not_a_client; a verb not offered gives invalid. The owner mod learns of it from hitch.changed@1 {resource:'items'} and applies it to its own data (the To-dos mod marks the to-do done).
